<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_ITSolutionRequest" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/it-solution-request">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ITRequest" name="IT solution request"/>
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_ITSolutionRequest">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Requester" name="Employee or department"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_IT" name="IT" processRef="Process_IT"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="Flow_Message_Request" name="Submit request" sourceRef="Participant_Requester" targetRef="StartEvent_Request"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IT" name="IT solution request handling" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Request" name="Request submitted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Request" messageRef="Message_ITRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Assess" name="Assess request (compatibility, cost and resources)"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval_Split" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure tools or licenses"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install solution"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test solution in controlled environment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out solution to requesting department"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Split" name="Training provided?" default="Flow_NoTraining"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Training" name="Provide training"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Training_Join" name="Training decision merged"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Support" name="Provide IT support for troubleshooting"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Operational" name="Solution in use with support available"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Declined" name="Request declined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Request" targetRef="Task_Assess"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_Assess" targetRef="Gateway_Approval_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="Task_Procure"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Not approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval_Split" targetRef="EndEvent_Declined"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Task_Rollout"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingYes" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Task_Training"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoTraining" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_Training" targetRef="Gateway_Training_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Gateway_Training_Join" targetRef="Task_Support"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_Support" targetRef="EndEvent_Operational"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
